prompts.inbox: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one final Chrome Web Store explainer graphic, landscape 8:5 aspect ratio for 1280x800 export. Match our established campaign: warm ivory #f6f3eb paper, near-black navy #14283b, vivid cobalt blue #1955e6, one hand-drawn orange underline, enormous bold Swiss grotesk typography, crisp flat ink, simple hand-drawn outline pictograms, slightly rotated rectangular editorial strips with thin navy rules. Beautiful disciplined spacing. This is an illustrated capability explainer, NOT a screenshot or fake app UI. No window chrome, dashboard, gradients, robots, 3D, logos or invented features. All text large and exceptionally legible, no tiny fine print. Small top brand line exactly "LinkedIn MCP – AI Connector". Headline on left in three strong lines: "Less inbox chaos.\nMore useful\nconversations." Underline "conversations." in orange. Right half shows three generously spaced stacked editorial strips with icons: search over speech bubble, two conversation bubbles, tray with checkmark. Exact strip text: "Find the conversation" / "Read the context" / "Reply and organize". Middle strip cobalt with white text. Bottom supporting sentence: "Ask your AI to search messages, read threads and send replies." Small but legible footer: "For Claude Code, Codex and local MCP clients." No other text.
